t: You're standing at the tomb of William Makepeace Thackeray, in Kensal Green Cemetery. Thackeray was an English novelist and illustrator, remembered above all for Vanity Fair, published in 1847 and 1848, a sweeping and satirical portrait of British society. He also wrote The Luck of Barry Lyndon, which Stanley Kubrick adapted for film in 1975. He lived from 1811 to 1863, and this is the monument that marks where he is commemorated.
